hook: Claude built a 3D film showing why your *fingers never really touch*
caption:
Developer An Xuan used Claude to build a 3D film about Zeno's paradox: two fingers move closer and the camera zooms down to the atoms.
The clip has pulled in millions of views on X, Dexerto reports.
The math says the endless halving still adds up to a finite distance, so your fingers do touch.

Would you watch a whole science class made like this?
